transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well... mostly I just don't feel like myself anymore. I've stopped doing pretty much everything. I stopped hiking, coaching... haven't played my guitar in a long time. I don't even call people back. Some days, I just sit in my small rental for hours. I know there are things I need to get done, but I just can't make myself start.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been... about a year and two months. Things really started unraveling since I moved into this smaller rental, right after my divorce.
Have there been any stretches of at least two months in the past year when you felt back to your usual self?

No... no, I don't think so. There hasn't been any time where I felt back to normal. Definitely not for a stretch of two months. It's pretty much just been... this same way, every day, since it all started.
During this past year, have there been times when you felt especially depressed or lost interest in things nearly every day for at least two weeks?

I don't know if I'd call it depressed, really. I mean, I'm not sitting around feeling sad or crying. I just... I don't care about things anymore. And it hasn't been a thing that comes and goes for two weeks here or there. It's just been this exact same flat feeling the entire time.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has a chronic, non-episodic depressive presentation lasting about 14 months with persistent loss of interest/pleasure, low motivation, and social withdrawal, with no symptom-free interval of 2 months or more. He denies discrete major depressive episodes, prominent sadness, or other evidence of an acute adjustment reaction. This pattern is most consistent with persistent depressive disorder (dysthymia).
